snippet.title: Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
For the first time ever, Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition will come to PlayStation 5 on November 4, 2025! Winner of 2021 Best Sim/Strategy Game at The Game Awards, this flagship title of the legendary Age of Empires franchise delivers the ultimate real-time strategy experience, now optimized for controller. 

Immerse yourself in 500 years of history from the Dark Ages up to the Renaissance across 4 epic campaigns and 35 missions. Choose from 10 diverse civilizations and battle across unique maps and biomes. 

Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition marks a bold new era of strategy—built for PlayStation 5. 

PRE-ORDER TODAY!

Stay connected with Age of Empires!
